description:
crate-jmap-contacts-types/README.md and PLAN.md describe an extensive 'jscontact/' typed-struct hierarchy with 18+ types (`Name`, `NameComponent`, `Nickname`, `Organization`, `OrgUnit`, `SpeakToAs`, `Pronouns`, `Title`, `EmailAddress`, `OnlineService`, `Phone`, `LanguagePref`, `Address`, `AddressComponent`, `Calendar`, `SchedulingAddress`, `CryptoKey`, `Directory`, `Link`, `Media`, `Anniversary`, `PartialDate`, `Note`, `PersonalInfo`, `Relation`) under modules `jscontact::name`, `jscontact::email`, `jscontact::phone`, etc.

**None of these modules exist.** Source layout is just `addressbook.rs`, `backend.rs`, `capability.rs`, `card.rs`, `lib.rs`, `string_enum.rs`. There is no `jscontact/` directory and no `pub mod jscontact`.

README 'How it works' explicitly says: "Typed sub-object structs (`Name`, `EmailAddress`, `Phone`, `Address`, etc.) are defined in the `jscontact/` module and are exported from the crate root" — false on both halves of the claim.

This appears to be the residue of the reverted `jmap-jscontact` crate (commit bb17f0f "revert: remove jmap-jscontact crate"). The contacts-types README and PLAN were never updated after the revert.

Action: rewrite README 'What' table and PLAN.md to reflect actual exported surface (just `AddressBook`, `ContactCard` (Value-shaped), `ContactsCapability`, `AddressBookProperty`, `ContactCardProperty`, etc.). Note in 'Known Limitations' that JSContact sub-objects are `Value`-shaped, not typed (which is already there but is currently contradicted by the rest of the README).

This is the most consequential README↔code mismatch in the workspace and is a publish-readiness blocker — readers will hit the docs.rs page and search for types that do not exist.
title: P1: contacts-types README and PLAN.md describe a jscontact/ module hierarchy that does not exist
